note: Who is eligible to referee, in which tier, and which node is asked. Answers stated from the rules.

cases.covers: only a node on the twins' model hash and weights digest is eligible
cases.name: same_model_hash_and_digest_only

cases.covers: the right model hash on other weights is not eligible
cases.name: different_digest_never_picked

cases.covers: the twins' weights digest under another model hash is not eligible
cases.name: different_model_hash_never_picked

cases.covers: neither twin referees its own pair
cases.name: twin_never_picked

cases.covers: a node that announced no key cannot sign a verdict
cases.name: no_announced_key_never_picked

cases.covers: a node this node stopped routing to is never asked
cases.name: blocked_node_never_picked

cases.covers: each other node fails exactly one condition
cases.name: one_eligible_among_the_rest

cases.covers: a node with a corroboration for this model is asked before a node with none
cases.name: tier1_before_tier2

cases.covers: with no corroborated node, the nodes with no history are asked
cases.name: cold_picked_only_when_tier1_empty

cases.covers: every member of the best tier can be asked, and no other node
cases.name: pick_uniform_within_best_tier

cases.covers: a corroborated node that is blocked does not hold the tier
cases.name: ineligible_tier1_node_leaves_tier2

cases.covers: a corroboration for another model does not lift a node's tier for this one
cases.name: corroboration_is_per_model

cases.covers: only a corroboration puts a node in the first tier
cases.name: inconclusive_is_not_a_corroboration

cases.covers: a node contradicted on this model is not asked about it
cases.name: contradiction_for_x_never_picked_for_x

cases.covers: the same node, asked about another model it serves
cases.name: contradiction_for_x_ok_for_y

cases.covers: a contradiction 29 days ago bars the node for this model
cases.name: barred_inside_d

cases.covers: a contradiction 31 days ago no longer bars it
cases.name: eligible_after_d

cases.covers: a later corroboration does not end the bar early
cases.name: corroboration_inside_d_does_not_clear

cases.covers: a bar on one model leaves the node eligible for another
cases.name: bar_on_x_leaves_y

cases.covers: with the setting unset the window is 30 days
cases.name: d_default_is_30

cases.covers: a 10-day window: a contradiction 20 days ago no longer bars
cases.name: d_from_setting_shorter

cases.covers: a 45-day window: a contradiction 40 days ago still bars
cases.name: d_from_setting_longer

cases.covers: the window runs from when this node recorded the verdict, not from the time the referee wrote on it
cases.name: bar_runs_from_this_nodes_clock

cases.covers: only a contradiction bars a node
cases.name: other_rulings_do_not_bar

cases.covers: a contradiction D days less one second ago still bars
cases.name: barred_one_second_inside_d

cases.covers: a contradiction exactly D days ago no longer bars
cases.name: eligible_at_exactly_d

cases.covers: a contradiction D days and one second ago no longer bars
cases.name: eligible_one_second_after_d

cases.covers: a corroboration dated inside the window does not put the node back in the first tier
cases.name: lapsed_contradiction_with_earlier_corroboration_is_tier2

cases.covers: a corroboration from before the contradiction does not count either
cases.name: lapsed_contradiction_with_older_corroboration_is_tier2

cases.covers: the bar lapsed 10 days ago and the node was corroborated 5 days ago: first tier again
cases.name: lapsed_contradiction_corroborated_after_the_lapse_is_tier1

cases.covers: the bar lapses 10 days before the clock; a corroboration one second earlier does not count
cases.name: corroborated_one_second_before_the_lapse_is_tier2

cases.covers: a corroboration one second after the lapse counts
cases.name: corroborated_one_second_after_the_lapse_is_tier1
